# Copilot repository instructions

Follow root `AGENTS.md` for source-of-truth, review, testing and safety requirements.
Use the existing codebase and conventional Python unittest/TypeScript testing where present.
Before coding, identify the parent issue, granular action in draft PR #42, file scope and acceptance criteria. Prefer the smallest change with tests; output exact validation commands and actual results.
Never claim permission to merge, deploy, run production migrations, change permissions or use Railway.
